operations.name: Get one blog post as markdown
operations.description: Returns the full body of a published blog post rendered as plain markdown, with a title heading, byline and excerpt blockquote. Intended for AI crawlers and retrieval pipelines that want the text without HTML. Success responses are `text/markdown`, not JSON; errors are JSON. No authentication and no rate limit; cached for one hour.

slug.description: Post slug, as returned in `posts[].slug.current` by listBlogPosts.

operations.name: Get modeled calls resolved counter
operations.description: Returns the modeled calls-resolved estimate used by the marketing homepage as two anchors five minutes apart. This is a mathematical model, not a live platform or warehouse query, so a caller can derive the apparent rate without the endpoint exposing a derivative. operations.name: List published blog posts
operations.description: Returns a page of published editorial blog posts ordered newest first, with the total count and a `hasMore` cursor flag. Body content is excluded. Call getBlogPostMarkdown with a slug from `posts[].slug.current` to read a post. No authentication and no rate limit. Responses are cached for one hour and invalidated when content is published.

page.description: 1-based page number. Values below 1 are clamped to 1.

limit.description: Posts per page. Clamped to the range 1-100.

operations.name: Submit the contact form
operations.description: Submits a general contact enquiry. The submission is forwarded to HubSpot; a HubSpot outage is logged server-side and still returns 200, so a success response means "accepted", not "delivered to CRM". No authentication. Cloudflare Turnstile is enforced only when the site is configured with a Turnstile secret. There is no per-IP rate limit on this endpoint. Use submitLead for programmatic lead capt

name.description: Full name of the person getting in touch.

company.description: Optional company name. Forwarded to HubSpot as an empty string when omitted.

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token. Only enforced when the site is configured with a Turnstile secret; a missing token then yields TURNSTILE_MISSING (400) and an invalid one TURNSTILE_INVALID (403).

operations.name: Submit a lead to a named form
operations.description: Universal lead capture. The `formSlug` selects a form definition in the CMS, which determines the accepted fields, their validation rules, the post-submit behaviour and the downstream destinations. The submission is stored synchronously; HubSpot and other destinations are pushed after the response is sent, so a 200 means "stored", not "synced". No authentication. formSlug.description: Slug of the form definition in the CMS. Determines validation and routing.

values.description: Field values keyed by the field names defined on the form in the CMS. Validation (required, email/phone/URL format, allowed options, max length, domain policy) is driven entirely by that form definition, so the accepted keys vary per `formSlug`.

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token. Required by default per form (`requireTurnstile`). A missing token or an unreachable Cloudflare fails OPEN; a supplied token that Cloudflare explicitly rejects fails CLOSED with 403 TURNSTILE_INVALID.

attribution.description: First-touch / last-touch attribution plus page context. Every field is optional.

event_id.description: Client-minted UUID v4 conversion id. Replaying the same valid UUID v4 `event_id` returns the original success envelope without re-firing HubSpot, downstream destinations, or ad conversions. Omitted or invalid IDs disable idempotency for compatibility with older clients; automatic retries can then create duplicate leads. Use crypto.randomUUID() and retain the same ID for retries.
